Dialogs.Dialog: Then I'll go buy something. Will you wait？
Okay. Be a good boy and wait, okay？ Just kidding.
Sorry to keep you waiting. Here, is this okay？
Of course. I'll be right back, so wait for me.
Sorry to keep you waiting, is this okay？
Welcome back. You didn't have to hurry, but thank you.
Hey, want to take a little break on that bench？
Let's take it easy a bit
Let's move on after a rest
I wouldn't mind staying right here all day...
As long as it's the two of us, anywhere, forever... Just kidding.
Okay. Hey, where do you want to go next？
Wherever you want to go, ▲高嶺＊＊▲！
Then I want to go wherever you want to go▼ Just kidding.
It's a bit hot today. Maybe I'll take off my jacket...
Really？ Then, excuse me a sec？
Ah... right. The sun's strong, isn't it？
Yeah. Okay, got it. I'll fan you. With my hand！
I'm cold too, so warm me up▼
Mm... but it's fine. If I snuggle up to you, I won't be cold.
Hey. Doesn't something smell good from that shop？
...I got some for you too. Here.
So, I'll go take a look. Wait here.
It seems it's not always open. Lucky, right？
Ah, a kitten. Would it let me pet it...
Um, you want me to pet your head？
Ah, hey, that's way too much petting！
Yeah. Let's try. Gently, so we don't scare it？
It was so cute, wasn't it？ But it only went to you...
The sun's so strong... I might get tanned.
Sun oil for a nice tan！
Hmm, so you like me tanned？
Then maybe I will. But I can put it on myself.
Then I'll do that. But I'm putting it on myself, okay？
What a pretty view... Hey, shall we take a picture？
Let's get someone to shoot us
Ah, that sounds nice. Ask someone.
Okay, decided. How about over there？
Lots of people. I wonder if it's popular？
But with you, it's fun. Strange, right？
Lots of happy-looking couples, and we're one of them.
Not many people... I wonder if it's not popular？
Isn't it a bit too quiet？
The calm mood is nice, no？
But it feels like we have the place to ourselves, which is kind of fun.
I see. Then let's enjoy it.
And we can easily be alone...？
Hehe, geez. But I think so too... Just kidding.
...But with you, the weather doesn't matter, right？
Hey. On the way home today, can I come to your place？
Yay▼ My heart was pounding, wondering what I'd do if you said no.
......Just kidding. Sorry for putting you on the spot. Next time, say yes, okay？
Hey, there's a fortune teller. Want to have our compatibility read？
No need, we know the answer
Your compatibility is the best. A bright future is certain！
"A bright future is certain！" she says？
That lady must be a famous fortune teller.
Your compatibility is pretty good. I'm sure it'll go well.
Hmm, we didn't really get that, did we？
Whatever happens, no problem！ I'm sure we can get through it！
Hey, look over there. Cute flowers are blooming.
If I'd been alone, I don't think I would have noticed.
Let's keep noticing all sorts of things like this from now on？ Together.
Geez. Don't say that with such a serious face.
...But that makes me happy. Thank you.
Ah. That's a girl from my class over there...
It's fine. I almost want to show off my date with you.
I see. So they can't compete with us, the perfect couple！
Geez, don't say that. ...Even if it's true. Just kidding▼
Hey. What would you do if I said... I'm not going home today？
I want to grow up soon...
Hey, your stomach growled just now...
Me？ Hmm, I train, so would I be tasty？
Geez, don't try to act tough.
Hey. Is your room the same as always？
Then I'll stay a long time and paint it Manaka-colored. Just kidding.
You tidied up for me. Thank you.
...But next time you can leave it. I'll do it. Okay？
Hey, if you redecorated your room, what kind of style would you want？
I like it as it is！
Yeah. It feels just like ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s room.
...Mm. Then I'll leave it as is？
You'll... think about it with me？
I'm so happy, thank you. When the time comes, please▼
Ah. I'll bring tea and snacks？
But in exchange, you can't go home until I say so, okay？ Just kidding.
Really？ Tell me if you want some.
...Is it weird that I'm still not used to being alone together in a room？
Not weird at all, I think
Happy, having fun, my heart racing so much I get anxious――
You too, huh. Somehow, I feel a little relieved.
Um, I don't mean I dislike it or anything, okay？
I don't know how to explain it...
